routes.rationale: Shortest path: a single Boc-protection cut on the free secondary amine of stock piperidin-3-one. The C3 ketone is pre-installed and inert to Boc2O/Et3N, so no oxidation-state manipulation is needed. Both terminals are exact stock hits (ev_003, ev_004). Caveat: validate_disconnection passed all structural checks (atom inventory conserved, no product leakage, class-compatible) but reported dataset_or_template_support=false, a flag that also failed for canonical Suzuki/amide controls, so confidence is moderate rather than high.

Two-step alternative with a distinct first disconnection: instead of protecting a pre-formed ketone, it cuts the target back to the C3 alcohol and installs the oxidation state last. Boc protection of stock piperidin-3-ol (ev_006) gives N-Boc-piperidin-3-ol, then Swern oxidation gives the ketone. This is the closest match to dataset chemistry, mirroring US05932595 (N-Cbz-piperidin-3-ol -> N-Cbz-piperidin-3-one, ev_002) and the piperidin-3-ol protection precedent (ev_036). It shares the Boc2O node with Route A and converges on the same target node; the intermediate is itself a confirmed stock item (ev_005), so the route can be shortened if preferred.
